sections.html: Noturus nocturnus Jordan & Gilbert, 1886. Common names: Freckled Madtom, Fregnet Giftmalle (Denmark). Family: Ictaluridae. Size: 15 cm SL. IUCN Red List category: Least Concern (last assessed 2012).

North America: Mississippi River basin from northern Illinois to Louisiana, and from eastern Kentucky to central Kansas and Oklahoma in the USA; Gulf Slope drainages from Mobile Bay in Alabama to Guadalupe River in Texas, USA.

Type locality: Saline River, near Benton railroad bridge, at Benton, Saline County, Arkansas, U.S.A.
Etymology: from the Greek notos, meaning back, and oura, meaning tail, in reference to the confluent adipose and caudal fins. The specific epithet refers to its black (nocturnus = night) colour.
Proceedings of the United States National Museum v. 9 (no. 549) (for 14 Aug. 1886), pp 6.
